turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, what's up? How are you doing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My bike's back tire has gone flat again.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Annoying. You could patch the inner tube yourself tonight, or take it to the shop tomorrow and get a sturdier tire. What would you like to do?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, Priya just called my name. Please wait and stay silent until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Priya, what did you get your brother last year?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A board game. He played it once and then forgot about it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ouch. So no games this time?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Probably not. I'm thinking concert tickets.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's way better. Who's he into these days?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Some jazz band I've never heard of. I'll ask his girlfriend.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure. We were sorting out your flat tire, patching it or taking it in.
